info.title: Viserio Cooldowns Public API
info.description: v1: roster, raid resets and setups, calendar events and signups, Mythic+ keys, loot, note and assignment structure, and a feed of what's changed, for your group. Your key can also write: add and update roster members, create and delete setups, set who plays on a setup and per-boss assignments, set signup statuses, import a droptimizer from a sim link, and push your group's in-game gear snapshot. Reads and writes share one hourly point budget for your group, and writes cost more. Still stabilizing, so pin to /v1 and expect occasional refinements before it is marked stable. See the ToS and Acceptable Use policies.

memberId.description: Opaque roster member id (not a Battle.net id).

status.description: Defaults to "alt" for a newly added character.

battletag.description: Only on unclaimed members; "" clears it.

mainCharacter.description: Promote this character (by player id) to the member's main.

role.description: The member's main role: set on the roster, or derived from their main character's spec.

responded.description: True once this signup carries a real answer: the member (or an officer on their behalf) set the status, or a declared time-away period covers this night. False while the status is only the night's starting value that nobody has confirmed. On a night where `autoConfirmed` is true the starting value already counts as the answer, so render by `status` and ignore this flag.

enabledBossSlugs.description: The bosses this setup plans to run, in its own order.

scheduleId.description: Owning schedule, or null for a manual event.

autoConfirmed.description: True when this night treats every signup's starting status as final (an opt-out night: members are counted at their starting status unless they change it). False when members are expected to reply; then each signup's `responded` says who actually has, and an unresponded signup should be shown as awaiting a reply rather than at its seeded status.

optional.description: True for an optional raid: the night is not included in attendance statistics. Set per schedule, with a per-night override.

linkedResets.description: Raid plans linked to this event. Empty when none.

anchoredSetups.description: Setups pinned to this event as their raid night. Empty when none.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last change to anything this object shows: the event itself, its signups, a signup role edited on the roster, or a linked plan. Safe to poll against.

id.description: Stable guest id within the event.

defaultRegion.description: The group's resolved region. Never the raw stored field.

serverTimeZone.description: IANA zone the dates and times in this list are expressed in. Resolved, so it is always a usable zone even for a group that never set one.

lastGeneratedUntil.description: How far events are generated (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.

comment.description: Optional note (max 500 chars). Omit to leave it unchanged.

characterName.description: The seated roster character, or null.

isGuest.description: True when the seat holds a hand-typed guest.

guestName.description: Guest name as entered, or null.

note.description: The occupant's own short note about their spot.

date.description: Run date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the group's region.

dungeons.description: Dungeons the group plans to run. Empty when untagged.

openSeatCount.description: How many of the five seats are free.

slots.description: The five seats, always in scarcity order.

defaultRegion.description: The group's resolved region. Never the raw stored field.

serverTimeZone.description: IANA zone the dates and times in this list are expressed in. Resolved, so it is always a usable zone even for a group that never set one.

characters.description: The characters this player would bring.

anytime.description: True when the player named no windows, meaning they are free whenever.

defaultRegion.description: The group's resolved region. Never the raw stored field.

serverTimeZone.description: IANA zone the dates and times in this list are expressed in. Resolved, so it is always a usable zone even for a group that never set one.

discordUserId.description: The member's linked Discord user id, or null when not linked.

signupTracked.description: Whether this group prefers to require signup answers; callers may use this as a preference signal.

simsTracked.description: Whether this group expects gear sims; callers may use this as a preference signal.

wishlistsTracked.description: Whether this group prefers to require loot wishlists; callers may use this as a preference signal.

droptimizerMaxAgeDays.description: Sims older than this many days count as stale.

notSignedUp.description: Members who have not answered the signup for this night.

staleSims.description: Members whose newest gear sim is older than the staleness window, or who never ran one.

missingWishlists.description: Members with no loot wishlist selections on any active character. Presence-based: wishlists have no staleness window.

kind.description: Whether a member acted for themselves, an officer acted, or an API key did.

name.description: Display name of who acted, when known.

changedByOfficer.description: True when someone other than the member themselves made the change.

memberId.description: Roster member the change is about, when it is about one.

eventDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the event, when known.

characterName.description: For an application: the character applied on.

characterClass.description: For an application: the character class.

role.description: For an application: the role applied as.

status.description: For an application decision: whether it was accepted or declined.

guildName.description: For a public-listing change (verified, unlisted, or taken over by another team): the guild the listing is for. On a takeover, only the guild name crosses this boundary — never the new holder's identity.

applyUrl.description: For an application decision: the applicant's application page, where they see the outcome.

applicantDiscordUserId.description: For an application decision: the applicant's Discord user id, present only when they linked Discord, so a bot can message them the outcome.

planName.description: For a plan published, unpublished or edited: the name of the plan.

bossName.description: For a cooldown plan that was edited: the boss it is for, with its difficulty.

changedKeys.description: For an edited event: which of the night's fields changed, so a consumer can say "the time moved" instead of just "something changed". Drawn from a closed set of publicly documented event fields; a change to anything outside it is simply not listed. Null for every other kind.

nextCursor.description: Position to poll from next. Always present.

id.description: Roster memberId when the character maps to a roster member, else the player id ("name-realm").

characterId.description: The assigned character's player id ("name-realm"). Matches `characters[].playerId` on the roster endpoint, so the two can be joined. Distinguishes which alt is assigned when a member has several.

characterName.description: The assigned character's own name, which differs from `displayName` when a member plays an alt.

enabled.description: False when the setup has this boss disabled (skipped). Disabling is non-destructive, so a skipped boss keeps its assignments.

tierId.description: Raid tier (season) the setup was created for. Null for setups created before tiers were tracked.

enabledBossSlugs.description: The bosses this setup plans to run, in its own order.

shareUrl.description: Shareable URL to this setup's player assignments page on the Viserio website. Distinct from the API-traversal `links` below, which point back into this API.

playerId.description: Player id ("name-realm") or roster member id.

spec.description: Spec for this boss. Omit to use the player's default spec.

active.description: true = in the setup, false = benched.

playerId.description: The resolved player id (when the request named a member id).

remainingSetupIds.description: The setups left on this reset. Empty is a valid state.

difficulty.description: Difficulty this pick is for; 'mplus' marks a dungeon drop.

note.description: The player's own note on this pick.
note.example: Only if the trinket does not drop.

done.description: Present only when the player has marked this pick finished: they took a good enough alternative and no longer want the item. Absent means still wanted.

dpsGainPercent.description: How much this item raises the character's damage, in percent, from the team's droptimizer sims: the same number the loot board shows for this pick. For a healer sim it is the healing gain. Absent when no sim covers the item.

hpsGainPercent.description: Healing gain in percent, present when the character's sim measured healing.

catalyzedIntoItemId.description: Present when the gain above is what the item is worth after a trip to the catalyst: the item it turns into.

baselineDps.description: The sim baseline (0 for QE Live healing reports).

reportUrl.description: Open the full sim at the source.

url.description: A Raidbots or QE Live report link, or its id.

profileKey.description: Optional: import just this profile when a report carries several. By default every profile the group tracks is imported. Send "raid-bonus-roll" with a Raidbots Droptimizer run on Mythic at upgrade 1/6 to value bonus rolls.

warnings.description: Non-blocking notes about the imported sims, across every imported profile.

imports.description: Every profile this call imported. A QE Live report can carry both a raid and an M+ scan; each imported one is an entry here, and the top-level fields describe the first.

warboundItems.description: Accepted and ignored. A warbound item belongs to the account rather than one character, so attributing it to a roster member would mark loot owned for someone who cannot be wearing it.

lastLogout.description: Unix seconds of last logout. 0 or omitted when never recorded.

items.description: Non-warbound items on this character: equipped, bags and bank.

itemId.description: Blizzard item id. Wins over the id inside `link`.

link.description: Full in-game item link. Bonus ids are read from it; omit and only item level ranks the item.

slotEquipped.description: Equipment slot id when equipped, null when in bags or bank.

charactersUpserted.description: Characters that had no snapshot before this push.

charactersReplaced.description: Characters whose snapshot this push replaced.

itemsStored.description: Items stored across every character in this push.

skipped.description: Rows dropped: characters with no usable items or over the cap, and cosmetic/duplicate items.

post.description: Add a person to the roster, optionally with their characters. Characters are matched against the character data Viserio already tracks for your group (for example the linked guild): class and spec come from there, and an unknown character rejects the write with a 400 naming it. A member with no characters yet does not appear in the roster export until one is added. Changes show up live for anyone with the roster open.

put.description: Partial update: omit a field to leave it unchanged; send "" to clear the battletag or alias. Characters merge additively: listed characters are added (or get the status you give them), unlisted characters are left alone; retire one with status "inactive". Making a character "main" also moves the member's main-character pointer. A claimed member's battletag cannot be changed here (it comes from their Battle.net account).

delete.description: Take a person off the roster. Their characters stay in the group's character pool, so nothing that already references them breaks — only the roster entry goes. They are also pulled from upcoming raid nights they had signed up for, and the raid size on those nights drops by one. Past events keep their name so history stays readable. Changes show up live for anyone with the roster open.

get.summary: What changed since your last poll
get.description: A forward-only feed of recent group activity: raid nights created, updated, cancelled, restored or deleted; signup status changes; applications submitted and decided; plans published, unpublished or edited and cooldown plans edited; people joining, leaving or being removed from the team, and roster spots being claimed; public guild listings verified, unlisted or taken over by another team; and Discord link changes. Call once without a cursor to get your starting position (history is never replayed), then poll with the returned cursor; each response hands back the next one. An empty poll answers a conditional request with 304, which is free of quota. Feed entries are retained for a limited time; poll at least daily to be safe.

post.summary: Import a droptimizer from a sim link
post.description: Send a Raidbots or QE Live report link (or its id) for a character on your group's roster, and we read the sim and add it to that character's loot board. The character must be on the roster. If the sim provider is busy or times out, the call returns a retryable error and nothing is saved, so a partial import can never happen — retry shortly. A QE Live report can carry both a raid and an M+ scan; every scan the group tracks is imported, or pass `profileKey` to import just one.

put.summary: Replace your group's gear snapshot (Owned Items)
put.description: Push in-game gear data so wishlist picks sitting in bags or the bank count as owned. The body is the raw WowUtils gear-snapshot export: an array of accounts, each with characters and their items. Each character named in the payload is replaced whole, so an item the player no longer holds disappears; characters not named are left untouched — a one-character array is the incremental path. An account `userId` is optional. Warbound items are accepted and ignored (they belong to the account, not one character). A row that cannot be read is skipped and counted in `skipped`, never the whole request. A group stores up to 500 characters; pushes for characters already stored always replace and never count against that limit.
